question: What is the parent technique of attack technique 'T1003.005: OS Credential Dumping: Cached Domain Credentials'?
answer_text:
Gathered 1 record(s) from 1 source(s).
Found ATT&CK record T1003.005: Cached Domain Credentials. T1003.005 (Cached Domain Credentials): Adversaries may attempt to access cached domain credentials used to allow authentication to occur in the event a domain controller is unavailable.(Citation: Microsoft - Cached Creds)

On Windows Vista and newer, the hash format is DCC2 (Domain Cached Credentials version 2) hash, also known as MS-Cache v2 hash.(Citation: PassLib mscache) The number of default cached credentials varies and can be altered per system.
